mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 13 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 17, low 8.

Kosovo opposition leader Jehona Lushaku-Sadriu said the government has made zero progress in ten chapters of EU integration, accusing it of stagnation.

LSDM chairman Venko Filipçe called on the Public Prosecutor's Office to immediately investigate Prime Minister Hristijan Mickoski over alleged false statements concerning the acquisition of Alta Bank.

The Special Appeals Court sentenced former Special Operations Force commander Oltion Bistri to seven years and four months in prison and ordered the seizure of €1.3 million in assets.

Manchester United has made an extraordinary financial offer to keep 16-year-old striker JJ Gabriel, but the teenager appears set to join Real Madrid instead.

Police reported a knife attack near the Economic High School in Gjilan, leaving two teenagers injured.
